scope: Read-only refinement of every previously failed support slab. No outward bead envelope is shrunk for the corrected-strict counts. Zero in earlier passing original slabs remains valid because per-record eligibility is a subset of the grouped conservative eligibility. Initial overlap remains failure of starting-envelope compatibility, not automatically a mechanical undercut lock.
method: Keep original circumscribed bead width/2+.002 footprint. Refine only each model record actual bottom instead of whole-layer minimum borrowed from another bridge. A model prism is encountered for downward shift s in [support_bottom-model_top, support_top-model_bottom] intersect s>=0. For each intersected STL triangle, its print Z is affine over projected XY: extrema over actual footprint intersection vertices give the exact vertical encounter interval bound. Original strict report untouched. Nominal-width diagnostic is separate, never used to release corrected-strict hits.
limits: Displacement bounds are numerical directions to separate nominal envelopes, not tolerances or permission to push physical intersecting solids.
Part/support adhesion, real bead cross section, surface damage, grip, and extraction force are unverified.
A positive bound does not automatically mean an undercut; check whether any obstacle lies below support starting bottom.
Tree regeneration is not a rigid .15 or .25mm clearance offset.
